mutations.label: cache-merge: a deletion actually removes the key, rather than only being counted
mutations.only: ^(?:a GREEN deletion by one shard survives the other eleven carrying its stale RED|when two shards measure one key, the deletion wins whichever order they arrive in|the CLI writes only when the merge held, and the workflow call is the one under test)$

mutations.label: cache-merge: an incomplete run is refused, not merged from whatever arrived
mutations.only: ^(?:a shard that never reported refuses the merge instead of freezing its keys|the CLI writes only when the merge held, and the workflow call is the one under test)$

mutations.label: cache-merge: a report with no `measured` claim is unreadable, not a shard that measured nothing
mutations.from: if (!Array.isArray(parsed.measured)) return { path, error: 'no measured claim' }
mutations.only: ^(?:a report that cannot say what it measured is no report, not an empty one)$

mutations.label: cache-merge: a deletion stays final when a later shard reports the same key RED
mutations.only: ^(?:when two shards measure one key, the deletion wins whichever order they arrive in)$

mutations.label: cache-merge: an option's operand is consumed, never collected as a thirteenth report
mutations.from: i += 1               // the OPERAND, never a path
mutations.only: ^(?:the CLI writes only when the merge held, and the workflow call is the one under test|the CLI refuses a call it cannot understand rather than guessing an output path)$

mutations.label: cache-merge: twelve reports are not twelve shards unless the identities are 1..n exactly once
mutations.only: ^(?:twelve reports are not twelve shards when one identity appears twice)$
